explanation: 동사 watch, hear, read가 or로 연결된 병렬 구조이므로 모두 동일한 원형(현재형) 형태여야 한다. 원문: "Every day we watch, hear, or read interesting news."

q: However, ___ whether an article is really true?
explanation: '경험'을 나타내는 현재완료(have+p.p.) 의문문으로, 의문문이므로 have가 주어 앞으로 도치된다. 원문: "However, have you ever seriously considered whether an article is really true?"

q: Everyone likes an interesting news story but what if it is ___?
explanation: 'be동사+부사+과거분사(make up의 수동형)' 순서로, 부사 completely는 과거분사 made up 앞에 위치한다. 원문: "Everyone likes an interesting news story but what if it is completely made up?"

q: Fake news can be very harmful in that it can make people ___.
explanation: make+목적어+목적격보어 구조에서 people이 '정보를 제공받고 잘못 이끌리는' 수동의 의미이므로 과거분사 informed, misled가 병렬로 쓰인다. 원문: "Fake news can be very harmful in that it can make people less informed or even misled."

q: Nevertheless, there ___ various fake news reports throughout history.
explanation: '계속'을 나타내는 현재완료이며 주어 reports가 복수이므로 have been이 적절하다. 원문: "Nevertheless, there have been various fake news reports throughout history."
'계속'을 나타내는 현재완료 의문문으로 Why 뒤에 have가 주어(some people) 앞에 위치하고 written(write의 과거분사)이 이어진다. 원문: "Why have some people written such false information?"

q: Let's look into some articles ___ about the hidden motives behind them.
explanation: 주절과 동시에 일어나는 동작을 나타내는 분사구문(= as we think about the hidden motives behind them)이므로 현재분사 thinking이 쓰인다. 원문: "Let's look into some articles thinking about the hidden motives behind them."

q: Last night, an angry group of rhinoceroses ___ the walls of the cage at the zoo and escaped.
explanation: last night이라는 명백한 과거 시점이 있으므로 break down의 불규칙 과거형 broke down이 쓰이고, 뒤의 escaped와 병렬을 이룬다. 원문: "Last night, an angry group of rhinoceroses broke down the walls of the cage at the zoo and escaped."

q: They also broke down the walls of the other ___.
explanation: 복수명사 animals의 소유격은 -s' 형태(animals')로 표시한다. 원문: "They also broke down the walls of the other wild animals' cages."

q: These animals ___ the streets and injured hundreds of people.
explanation: run의 불규칙 과거형은 ran이며, 뒤의 injured와 병렬 구조를 이루는 과거시제이다. 원문: "These animals ran down the streets and injured hundreds of people."
